newsitem.title: USA: CME feeder cattle speed higher in fast trading.
newsitem.headline: CME feeder cattle speed higher in fast trading.

text.p: CME feeder cattle futures turned higher at mid-morning and increased gains in fast trading in reaction to lower CBOT corn futures, traders said.

The lower corn futures added to an already existing bullish trend for feeder cattle. Traders have said lush pastures will encourage grazing cattle longer, keeping them away from sale barns and helping boost prices on the tight numbers made available for sale, traders said.
At 1046 CDT, feeder cattle were up 0.150 to 0.375 cent per lb in the 1997 contracts with August up 0.275 at 81.150 cents a lb.
